proposedChange.question: Which cases are retained long term?
proposedChange.proposal: Local QA remains existing 7/30 days. Formal drafts, approved deliveries and audit references each require explicit purpose/jurisdiction/Owner retention, no permanent default.

proposedChange.question: Who may reopen?
proposedChange.proposal: Keep Account custodian + Business Subject + current purpose/resource/member scope. A shared enterprise custody model is an independent future decision, not current support.

proposedChange.question: Consultant leaves?
proposedChange.proposal: Expiry/revocation blocks access immediately; no retained client-file access. New access requires separate client grant.

proposedChange.question: Business revokes?
proposedChange.proposal: Block new reads; preserve existing delivery/audit history pending approved retention/legal-hold decision. Never equate revoke with delete.

proposedChange.question: Duplicate requests?
proposedChange.proposal: Reuse native Account/Subject/request ID + digest reservation; replay same input, reject conflicting reuse. New formal grant/output pins need approved metadata version.

proposedChange.question: Retention expires?
proposedChange.proposal: Deny reopen first. No cleanup worker is authorized here; approved auditable deletion must respect record class, holds and encryption/backups.

proposedChange.question: Loss/concurrency/recovery?
proposedChange.proposal: Current same-request concurrency and fresh-process decrypt are verified. PENDING/orphan/key-loss cases stay explicit, not auto-COMPLETE; an Owner-reviewed reconciliation/recovery procedure is still required.
